sentences.ar: بيوم، سمع الأسد صوت غريب وقوي.
sentences.en: One day, the lion heard a strange, powerful sound.

sentences.ar: خاف بس ما بده حدا يعرف إنه خايف.
sentences.en: He was afraid but did not want anyone to know it.
Dimna noticed the fear in his eyes.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا بروح بشوف شو هاد الصوت.
sentences.en: He said: I will go and see what this sound is.
The sound belonged to an ox named Shatraba.

sentences.ar: كان ضايع عن أصحابه وبيخور من الجوع.
sentences.en: He had been lost from his people and was bellowing from hunger.
Dimna brought him to the lion.
